relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
summary: The Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador's audited 2023 financial statements put the whole of its physical gold with the Bank for International Settlements, which is the only institution the gold note names.
detail: Note 4, 'Oro', of the Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador's 2023 annual financial statements lists the holding under the heading 'Depositos en Oro Fisico' against one institution, the Bank for International Settlements, and adds that the gold deposits are free of lien or pledge. The statements carry an independent auditor's report by PricewaterhouseCoopers, Ltda. de C.V., engagement partner Wilfredo Peralta, dated 28 February 2024. A second PwC-audited El Salvador document opened separately in this round, the 'Estado de los activos que respaldan la reserva de liquidez' at 31 December 2023 (https://transparencia.gob.sv/institutions/bcr/documents/593992/download), carries the same fact in its own Note 7 'Depositos de oro': a single line, 'Bank For International Settlements $90,964,193.72', against physical gold holdings of 44,105.998 troy ounces. The two documents agree with each other and with an earlier round's independent reading of the same note.
